name: Taco Salad
description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, and crushed taco chips, mixed with Catalina dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (250 g) bag cheese taco chips, crushed

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in the chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, Catalina dressing

_similar.name: Nacho Salad
_similar.description: A spicy nacho salad with ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and nacho chips, topped with a creamy dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (or mozzarella), shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain excess fat.
Add spices and water to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.
In a large salad bowl, mix together the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and crushed nacho chips.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, relish, ketchup, and hot pepper sauce.
Pour the dressing over the salad and add the cooled meat mixture.
Toss the salad to combine all ingredients and serve.

_similar.keywords: nacho salad, spicy salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Layered Coleslaw Salad
_similar.description: A layered coleslaw salad with shredded carrots, snow peas, and a creamy Miracle Whip dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (8.5 oz) Oriental flavor dry noodles

recipeInstructions.text: Shred cabbage and place in bottom of large glass bowl. Top with remaining ingredients in order given.
Combine Miracle Whip, sour cream, and package of noodle seasoning. Spread evenly over salad.
Cover and let stand overnight.

_similar.keywords: layered coleslaw, creamy dressing, overnight salad

_similar.name: Cornbread Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad
